mixedHelp: Add images and MP4 together. Covers match original stems exactly. Animated GIF/WebP count as static images. Uploads remain drafts.
mp4Help: Original and preview videos must be MP4. Images: 50 MiB max; videos: 200 MiB max.
fallback: Without a browser preview, playback depends on the original video codec.
issues: Unmatched or conflicting files (remove and add again)
duplicate-origin: Multiple originals share this stem; rename them
duplicate-cover: Multiple covers share this stem; rename them
duplicate-preview: Multiple preview videos share this stem
orphan: No original with the exact stem (case-sensitive)
unsupported: Unsupported format, MIME or size; convert videos to MP4
preview-mismatch: Preview requires live media and the exact original filename
blocked: Resolve conflicts and missing files before uploading.
publishScope: Only the assets selected below will publish. Select older drafts explicitly to include them.
choosePrimary: Choose the primary for this category and media type
visibility: Device visibility affects both static and live collections; published assets become visible together.
ackVisibility: I confirm enabling device visibility and restoring published assets in other collections.
unpublishHelp: Only published assets of this media type are unpublished. Drafts and the other type keep their status.
prefixHelp: Affects future uploads only. Existing files stay in place. Static and live assets share this directory. The first authorization saves the suggested directory; you can configure it in advance.
empty: Upload the first asset to start this collection
prefixChanged: Directory changed; previous grants were cleared. Check the queue again.
authorizedLocked: Files with upload grants cannot be replaced. Retry the item, or remove it and upload with a new filename.
expiredUploaded: Upload grants expired after files were uploaded. Reconcile the object list below with database references before cleanup. Use new filenames for a new upload.
targetChange: Changing the upload target clears this queue and its grants. Select files and check them again. Continue?
outsideRoles: Assets must be directly inside origin, compress or preview. Only notes and system files outside these folders are ignored.
